text:
amanda: Quick check — final draft of the product post is in Drive: https://drive.google.com/prod-post-v5. Need sign-off on the benchmark paragraph and CTA mapping to webinar flow. Can folks review by EOD?
brian: On it. Will skim benchmark numbers and confirm wording. Specifically worried about the '2-3x cost reduction' claim — do we have a source?
sophie: Added inline comments on the doc. Benchmark paragraph reads OK but let's soften 'guaranteed' -> 'observed' and cite internal eval id eval-2026-03-15.
brian: Agree with Sophie. Also for the CTA, can we map to the webinar reg page + a 'Request a demo' path for enterprise leads?
amanda: Yes — plan: primary CTA = Register for webinar (utm=webinar_launch), secondary CTA = Request demo (utm=request_demo). Need design to prepare two hero buttons and one footer link.
design-team: Can take the hero button assets. What's the exact copy? Options: `Register for live demo` / `See Redwood in action` / `Save my spot`.
marco: Marketing input: use 'Save your spot' (more urgency) and secondary 'Request a demo' (title case).
jim: Legal quickpass: avoid the word 'guarantee'. Also for benchmark numbers please add 'internal testing' footnote. Otherwise OK.
legal-bot: Legal note added to doc: "Results from internal testing; your results may vary."
amanda: Thanks. Brian/Sophie, confirm numbers and can we get final copy changes by 3pm? I'll coordinate HubSpot UTMs.
brian: Confirmed — updated the benchmark sentence to "observed up to 2.3x cost reduction in internal tests (see eval-2026-03-15)." pushed to doc at 13:04.
sophie: :thumbsup: Looks good. design-team can you drop hero buttons by 4pm? I'll prep the webinar landing page content.
design-team: On schedule. dropping hero + footer assets to /marketing/assets/hero-buttons.zip by 15:45.
amanda: Perfect. Last ask — can someone add the webinar invite to the public calendar and create a tracking tag in HubSpot (tag: post_launch_webinar_march2026)?
marco: I'll set up the HubSpot tag and routing: webinar registrants -> SDR queue 'Webinar_Inbound'; Request demo -> AE queue 'ProdLaunch_Demo'.
jim: Routing OK with security. make sure PII minimized on reg form.
amanda: Thanks all! I'll merge final and schedule publish for Tuesday 09:00 PT. :rocket:
